review.{n} object: Czech plural: 2-4 should be 'objekty'; chose 'objekt'/'objektů' as the pair, check wording or whether the UI can pick forms
review.Sliced: 'Naslicováno' is a coined past tense of Slicovat; check
review.Revert: Revert vs Undo (Zpět) kept distinct as 'Vrátit změnu'
review.your app: Case clash: 'v aplikaci {app}' needs locative, 'Čekání na {app}' accusative. 'vaši aplikaci' fits the second, reads a bit odd in the first (v aplikaci vaši aplikaci). Consider 'tuto aplikaci'/rewrite sentence.
review.Main menu (beside File) > Plugins > Orca: Words taken from OrcaSlicer .po (File, Plugins, Config)
review.Needs the OrcaSlicer MCP build: 'build' = the OrcaSlicer MCP fork build (version of the app); check wording
review.note: Heading/status use locative/accusative of 'vaše aplikace' as the sentence needs.
review.Settings › Plugins › Add › Add MCP serve: ChatGPT desktop route (orcaslicer-mcp OrcaCloud comment, 2026-11-13): the menu path and the box names are the ChatGPT desktop app's own words in this language (its locale files, app 26.1103), so they match what the user sees there.
